cards.hint: Think about lab testing with airflow.
options: Drag coefficients are almost always determined experimentally
Drag coefficients are calculated only from theory
Drag coefficients are taken from engine thrust tables
cards.quote: Drag coefficients are almost always determined experimentally using a wind tunnel.
cards.stem: How are drag coefficients almost always determined?

cards.hint: Compare wing size with cross section.
options: If we choose the wing area
If we use the total engine thrust
If we measure the air viscosity alone
cards.quote: If we choose the wing area, rather than the cross-sectional area, the computed coefficient will have a different value.
cards.stem: What choice leads to a different computed coefficient value?

cards.hint: Recall the list of drag sources mentioned.
options: The drag coefficient given above includes form drag
The drag coefficient excludes all friction effects
The drag coefficient equals net engine thrust
cards.quote: The drag coefficient given above includes form drag, skin friction drag, wave drag, and induced drag components.
cards.stem: Which component is included in the drag coefficient given above?
